boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring Quinnipiac traditions and signature annual gatherings documented by the university.

cards.title: Welcome Weekend
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus • before fall classes
cards.notes: Join the welcome ceremony, barbecue and scheduled activities after move-in; check the university’s current orientation and event details before attending.
cards.short_summary: A pre-semester welcome sequence that pairs move-in support with campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac describes Welcome Weekend as occurring the week before fall classes, with upper-class move-in assistance and events including a welcome ceremony and BBQ.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: Timing is listed as the week before the first day of fall-semester classes; consult current university programming.

cards.title: Engagement Fair
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus • first week of classes
cards.notes: Walk the organization tables during the first week of classes and ask groups about meetings, membership and how to get involved.
cards.short_summary: An annual early-semester opportunity to connect with Quinnipiac’s student-run organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says its annual Engagement Fair encourages undergraduates to learn about and sign up for its 190+ student-run organizations.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: The university places the fair during the first week of classes; organization participation and details vary by year.

cards.title: Bobcat Weekend
cards.subtitle: Quinnipiac campuses • fall
cards.notes: Attend a scheduled campus event with visiting family, alumni and fellow Bobcats; use the current Bobcat Weekend schedule to choose activities.
cards.short_summary: A fall campus weekend that brings students, families and alumni together.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says Bobcat Weekend annually invites parents, families and alumni back in the fall and offers events for the wider Bobcat community.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: Held in fall; individual events and any registration requirements are set in the current weekend schedule.

cards.title: Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus • fall semester
cards.notes: Catch the outdoor concert and festival with the announced artists and DJs; follow Student Programming Board updates for the year’s program.
cards.short_summary: A Student Programming Board and WQAQ-FM concert-and-festival tradition in the fall.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac identifies Fall Fest as a Student Programming Board and WQAQ-FM co-sponsored outdoor concert and festival celebrating the second half of fall semester.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: The university describes it as a fall-semester event; the performer lineup and event logistics change annually.

cards.entity_name: Heroes Hat Men’s Ice Hockey Versus Yale Game
cards.title: Heroes Hat Men’s Ice Hockey Versus Yale Game
cards.subtitle: M&T Bank Arena • annual Yale hockey rivalry
cards.notes: Watch Quinnipiac host Yale and learn the meaning of the Heroes Hat, which honors people who risked or lost their lives after September 11.
cards.short_summary: The annual Yale hockey matchup played for a memorial rivalry trophy.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says its men’s hockey team annually hosts Yale for the Heroes Hat, which honors people who risked or lost their lives following the September 11 attacks.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: Held at M&T Bank Arena when Quinnipiac hosts Yale; confirm the current athletics schedule and ticket information.

cards.title: Quad Lighting
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus Quad • after Thanksgiving break
cards.notes: Gather on the Quad for the university’s seasonal lights and community programming, then check the current holiday schedule for the event date.
cards.short_summary: The annual lighting gathering that marks Quinnipiac’s holiday season.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac describes an annual Quad lighting where the university community gathers to illuminate the holiday season, scheduled after Thanksgiving break.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: The university lists this after Thanksgiving break; verify the current date, weather plan and associated programming.

cards.title: Undergraduate Holiday Dinner
cards.subtitle: Carl Hansen Student Center • holiday season
cards.notes: Plan to share the seasonal dinner with classmates and watch for university details; faculty and staff volunteer as servers and hosts.
cards.short_summary: A faculty-and-staff-supported seasonal dinner for Quinnipiac undergraduates.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac reported that its 2024 Undergraduate Holiday Dinner marked 40 years of tradition, with faculty and staff serving and hosting students in Carl Hansen Student Center.
cards.source_title: Joyous Undergraduate Holiday Dinner celebrates 40 years of tradition | Quinnipiac Today
cards.access_notes: The university schedules holiday dinners after Thanksgiving break; confirm eligibility and current event details before attending.

cards.title: QTHON
cards.subtitle: Quinnipiac University • spring semester
cards.notes: Support Connecticut Children’s through the year-long initiative, then join the day-long dance event for games, music and the fundraising reveal.
cards.short_summary: A student-led fundraising tradition culminating in a day-long dance event.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac describes QTHON as a year-long, student-led fundraising initiative for Connecticut Children’s, celebrated with a day-long dance event in spring.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: Listed for spring semester; consult the current QTHON information for participation and event arrangements.

cards.title: The Big Event
cards.subtitle: Connecticut community sites • April
cards.notes: Volunteer with a nonprofit through the annual service day; review current sign-up details and prepare for the assigned community project.
cards.short_summary: A large annual service day connecting the Quinnipiac community with Connecticut nonprofits.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says The Big Event is an annual April day of service across Connecticut involving students, faculty, staff and alumni with nonprofit organizations.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: The university lists the event in April; project sites, transportation and registration are determined for each year.

cards.title: Wake the Giant
cards.subtitle: Quinnipiac University • spring semester
cards.notes: Attend the annual Student Programming Board concert and check the announced headliner, venue and entry instructions through official event updates.
cards.short_summary: A spring headliner concert staged annually by the Student Programming Board.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says the Student Programming Board produces Wake the Giant as an annual spring concert with a chosen headliner for the student body.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: Listed for spring semester; the performer, venue and entry instructions are announced for the current event.
